paper_title: Search for ultralight dark matter in the SuperMAG high-fidelity dataset
notes: Paper constrains both DPDM (kinetic mixing epsilon) and axion DM (g_agamma). Primary/highlighted result is DPDM, surpassing Leo T near m_A'~2e-15 eV. Limits presented only as bands in Fig. 3 (no numerical table), so data_points are rough estimates read from the smoothed 95%-credible upper limit curve over 4e-18-4e-15 eV. Frequency range 1e-3 to 0.98 Hz.
